correctness.rationale: Under the existential k-distance definition, selected vertices must be pairwise Manhattan-separated by at most k=2 or3. Therefore their unique occupied bounding box has height and width at most k+1, hence <=4. Every shortest grid path is coordinate-monotone inside its endpoint bounding box; moving an anchored configuration to a larger rectangle does not change visibility. The given 16 h,w profiles for each k exhaust all nonempty anchored sets, verified with two independent shortest-route algorithms and a fresh independent Python enumeration of all 32 local box cases. Every ambient set has a UNIQUE translated anchored box, with exactly (m-h+1)_+ (n-w+1)_+ placements. Summing yields the complete cardinality polynomials for all m,n>=2; k2 degree<=4 and k3 degree<=6. The 3x3 coefficient vectors are k2 (1,9,26,24,1), k3 (1,9,34,64,29,4), and 4x4 k3 (1,16,90,212,140,32,4). No extrapolation from finite grid sizes is needed once the bounding-box lemma is proved.
